title: LATTEArena: An Evaluation Framework for LLM-powered Tabular Feature Engineering (Extended Version)
abstract: arXiv:2606.09004v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Feature engineering remains a cornerstone of tabular data analysis, and Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for its automation, giving rise to LLM-powered Automated Tabular Feature Engineering (LATTE). However, the field lacks standardized, cost-aware evaluation platforms, and the combinatorial explosion of design choices obscures true algorithmic progress. To bridge these gaps, we systematically deconstruct 15 representative LATTE methods into a unified 6-dimensional taxonomy. Based on this abstraction, we introduce LATTEArena, a standardized, modular, and extensible benchmarking framework that decouples monolithic pipelines into reusable execution blocks. By distilling the massive combinatorial space, we evaluate 24 core LATTE configurations across 7 research questions. translated_title: LATTEArena：面向基于大语言模型的表格特征工程的评估框架（扩展版）
translated_abstract: 特征工程仍然是表格数据分析的基石，而大语言模型（LLM）已成为实现其自动化的有前景的范式，由此催生了基于大语言模型的自动化表格特征工程。然而，该领域缺乏标准化、考虑成本的评估平台，且设计选择的组合爆炸掩盖了真正的算法进步。为了弥合这些差距，我们将15个代表性的LATTE方法系统地解构为统一的6维分类体系。基于这一抽象，我们提出了LATTEArena——一个标准化、模块化且可扩展的基准测试框架，它将单体流水线解耦为可复用的执行模块。通过对庞大的组合空间进行提炼，我们围绕7个研究问题评估了24种核心LATTE配置。我们的直接对比基准测试不仅限于预测准确率，还量化了token效率和执行鲁棒性，得出了17条经验性结论……
tldr: 提出了LATTEArena——一个标准化、模块化、可扩展的基准测试框架，将15种LLM驱动的表格特征工程方法解构为统一的6维分类体系，并超越预测准确率，对token效率与执行鲁棒性进行了量化评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes LATTEArena, a standardized, modular, and extensible benchmarking framework that deconstructs 15 LLM-powered tabular feature engineering methods into a unified 6-dimensional taxonomy, evaluating 24 core configurations beyond predictive accuracy by quantifying token efficiency and execution robustness.
